rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is expressed in speech rather than in writing, gestures, or actions.

example.english: You need to explain this application verbally; you can't just write it down.
example.traditional: 呢份申請要口頭上講清楚，唔可以淨係寫低。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 san1 cing2 jiu3 hau2 tau4 soeng6 gong2 cing1 co2 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 se2 dai1

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone conveys something by actually speaking it aloud.

example.english: If you're unhappy, say it verbally instead of just sulking.
example.traditional: 有咩唔滿意就用口講，唔好淨係黑面。
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 zau6 jung6 hau2 gong2 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hak1 min6
